```{r}
source('Brownian_motion.R',keep.source = TRUE)
source('EM.R',keep.source = TRUE)
source('plots.R',keep.source = TRUE)
library(Rcpp)
sourceCpp("DoubleWell.cpp") # functions for Strang splitting and likelihood 

########################################################
# Step 1: Definer 0=t_0<t_1<...<t_N=T og drift- og noise-funktioner
########################################################
t_0 <- 0
N <- 300000
h <- 0.0001
T <- N*h
times <- seq(t_0,N*h,length.out=N+1)
# noisy_times <- sort(times + rnorm(length(times), mean = 0, sd = 0.1))

# drift term
F <- function(x,theta = c(0.25, -0.05)){
  eps<-theta[1]; y<-theta[2]
  (x[1]-x[1]^3-y)/eps
}


# additive noise term
G <- function(x, Sigma = c(1.4)) Sigma

########################################################
# Step 3: Euler-Maruyama simulation af SDE løsningen med plots. M_reps repetitions.
########################################################

x0 <- c(0)
n_paths <- 500
paths <- EM_sim_fast(F,G,x0,times,n_paths,progress = TRUE)

# Plot første repetition
plot_variable_vs_time(paths[[1]],times,to_time = T)

# Definer eventuelt sub paths
ratio <- 400
sub_h <- h*ratio
sub_times <- seq(t_0,N*h,length.out=N/ratio+1)
idx <- seq(1,N+1,by=ratio)
sub_paths <- lapply(paths, function(path) {
  df <- as.data.frame(path)
  # ensure idx are in bounds
  valid_idx <- idx[idx <= nrow(df)]
  df_sub <- df[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(df_sub) == 1) {
    names(df_sub) <- "X"
  }
  df_sub
})
plot_variable_vs_time(sub_paths[[6]],sub_times,T)
```

```{r}
fit_for_center <- function(method,
                           sub_paths,
                           sub_times,
                           show_progress = FALSE) {

  n_paths <- length(sub_paths)

  preds <- vector("list", n_paths)

  for (i in seq_along(sub_paths)) {

    if (show_progress) {
      message("fitting path ", i, " / ", n_paths)
    }

    this_path <- sub_paths[[i]]

    par0 <- c(0.5, 0, 0.1)

    obj <- function(par, path, times) {

      if (par[1] < 0.001 || par[1] > 1)
        return(1e20)

      if (par[2] < -0.37 || par[2] > 0.37)
        return(1e20)

      if (par[3] < 0.001)
        return(1e20)

      roots <- polyroot(c(-par[2], 1, 0, -1))
      real_roots <- Re(roots[abs(Im(roots)) < 1e-8])

      if (length(real_roots) < 3)
        return(1e20)

      real_roots <- sort(real_roots)

      left_fix  <- real_roots[1]
      uns_fix   <- real_roots[2]
      right_fix <- real_roots[3]

      b_vec <- NULL

      if (method == "fix") {

        b_vec <- c(left_fix, right_fix)

      } else if (method == "all fix") {

        b_vec <- c(left_fix, uns_fix, right_fix)

      } else if (method == "left fix") {

        b_vec <- c(left_fix)

      } else if (method == "wrong fix") {

        b_vec <- c(right_fix, left_fix)

      } else if (method == "random") {
        x_vals <- path[,1]
        b_vec <- runif(1,min(x_vals),max(x_vals))

      } else if (method == "average") {
        x_vals <- path[,1]
        b_vec <- mean(x_vals)

      } else if (method == "pi") {
        b_vec <- 3.14159

      } else if (method == "zero") {
        b_vec <- 0

      } else if (method == "0.5") {
        b_vec <- 0.5

      } else if (method == "uns") {

        b_vec <- uns_fix

      } else if (method == "minimax steps") {

        x_vals <- path[,1]
        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 2001)

        b_vec <- minimax_steps_cpp(
          x_vals, c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3]
        )

      } else if (method == "argminBargminV steps") {

        x_vals <- path[,1]
        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 2001)

        b_vec <- argminBargminV_steps_cpp(
          x_vals, c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3],
          tol = 0.1
        )

      } else if (method == "argminVargminB steps") {

        x_vals <- path[,1]
        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 2001)

        b_vec <- argminVargminB_steps_cpp(
          x_vals, c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3],
          tol = 0.1
        )

      } else if (method == "minimax wells 3") {

        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 301)

        b_vec <- wells_bvec_trap_cpp(
          "minimax wells",
          c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3],
          split_mode = "thirds",
          uns_fix
        )

      } else if (method == "argminVargminB wells 3") {

        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 301)

        b_vec <- wells_bvec_trap_cpp(
          "argminVargminB wells",
          c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3],
          split_mode = "thirds",
          uns_fix,
          tol = 0.1
        )

      } else if (method == "argminBargminV wells 3") {

        c_grid <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 301)

        b_vec <- wells_bvec_trap_cpp(
          "argminBargminV wells",
          c_grid,
          par[1], par[2], par[3],
          split_mode = "thirds",
          uns_fix,
          tol = 0.1
        )

      } else if (method == "local") {

        b_vec <- path[,1]
      }

      res <- tryCatch(
        log_lik_path_rcpp(
          as.matrix(path),
          times,
          c(par[1], par[2]),
          par[3],
          method = method,
          b_vec = b_vec,
          uns_fix = uns_fix,
          fh_solver = "rk4"
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(res) || !is.finite(res$ll))
        return(1e20)

      res$ll
    }

    fit <- tryCatch(
      optim(
        par = par0,
        fn = obj,
        path = this_path,
        times = sub_times,
        method = "Nelder-Mead",
        control = list(
          maxit = 5000,
          trace = 0
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    preds[[i]] <-
      if (is.null(fit) || !is.finite(fit$value))
        rep(NA_real_, length(param_labels))
      else
        fit$par
  }

  preds_mat <- do.call(rbind, preds)
  colnames(preds_mat) <- param_labels

  as.data.frame(preds_mat)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

run_experiment <- function(
    paths,
    ratios,
    methods,
    method_names,
    fit_fun,
    t_0,
    N,
    h
) {

  all_estimates <- data.frame()

  for (ratio in ratios) {

    message("Ratio = ", ratio)

    sub_times <- seq(
      t_0,
      N * h,
      length.out = N / ratio + 1
    )

    idx <- seq(1, N + 1, by = ratio)

    sub_paths <- lapply(paths, function(path) {

      df <- as.data.frame(path)
      valid_idx <- idx[idx <= nrow(df)]
      df[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    })

    for (k in seq_along(methods)) {

      message("  Method: ", method_names[k])

      est <- fit_fun(
        method = methods[k],
        sub_paths = sub_paths,
        sub_times = sub_times
      )

      tmp <- est
      tmp$path <- seq_len(nrow(tmp))
      tmp$ratio <- ratio
      tmp$sub_h <- h * ratio
      tmp$method <- method_names[k]

      all_estimates <- rbind(all_estimates, tmp)
    }
  }

  all_estimates
}
make_long_estimates <- function(all_estimates, true_params, param_labels) {

  est_long <- pivot_longer(
    all_estimates,
    cols = c(epsilon, y, sigma),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "estimate"
  )

  truth_df <- data.frame(
    parameter = param_labels,
    truth = true_params
  )

  est_long <- left_join(est_long, truth_df, by = "parameter")

  est_long$parameter <- factor(
    est_long$parameter,
    levels = param_labels
  )

  est_long
}
compute_metric_df <- function(est_long, metric = c("MSE", "ARE")) {

  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  est_long %>%
    mutate(
      value = if (metric == "MSE") {
        (estimate - truth)^2
      } else {
        abs(estimate - truth) / abs(truth)
      }
    ) %>%
    group_by(ratio, sub_h, method, parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
plot_metric <- function(est_long,
                        metric = c("MSE", "ARE"),
                        methods_keep = NULL) {

  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  metric_df <- compute_metric_df(est_long, metric)

  if (!is.null(methods_keep)) {
    metric_df <- metric_df %>%
      filter(method %in% methods_keep)
  }

  ggplot(metric_df,
         aes(x = sub_h, y = value, color = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "h",
      y = metric,
      color = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
plot_raw_estimates <- function(est_df,
                               true_params,
                               param_labels,
                               ratio_value = NULL,
                               method_names,
                               title_text = NULL,
                               normalize = FALSE,
                               cap_outliers = FALSE,
                               methods_keep = NULL) {

  

  if (!is.null(ratio_value)) {
    est_df <- est_df %>%
      filter(ratio == ratio_value)
  }

  if (!is.null(methods_keep)) {
    est_df <- est_df %>%
      filter(method %in% methods_keep)
  }

  true_df <- tibble(
    parameter = param_labels,
    true_value = true_params
  )

  est_df <- est_df %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(method, levels = method_names),
      parameter = factor(parameter, levels = param_labels)
    ) %>%
    left_join(true_df, by = "parameter") %>%
    mutate(plot_value = estimate)


  # optional trimming of outliers
  if (cap_outliers) {
    est_df <- est_df %>%
      group_by(parameter, method) %>%
      filter(
        plot_value >= quantile(plot_value, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
        plot_value <= quantile(plot_value, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  truth_lines <- tibble(
    parameter = param_labels,
    true_value = true_params
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    est_df,
    aes(x = method, y = plot_value, fill = method)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

  p <- p +
    geom_hline(
      data = truth_lines,
      aes(yintercept = true_value, linetype = "True parameter"),
      color = "gold",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "",
      values = c("True parameter" = "dashed")
    )

  p <- p +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ parameter,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Method",
      y = if (normalize) "(Estimate - True) / True" else "Estimate"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "Times") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
all_estimates <- run_experiment(
  paths = paths,
  ratios = c(400,600,800,1000),
  methods = c("random","local","average","pi","zero","0.5","uns","wrong fix","fix","all fix","argminVargminB steps","argminBargminV steps","minimax steps","argminVargminB wells 3","argminBargminV wells 3","minimax wells 3"),
  method_names = c("random","local","average","pi","zero","0.5","uns","wrong fix","fix","all fix","argminVargminB steps","argminBargminV steps","minimax steps","argminVargminB wells 3","argminBargminV wells 3","minimax wells 3"),
  fit_fun = fit_for_center,
  t_0 = t_0,
  N = N,
  h = h
)

est_long <- make_long_estimates(
  all_estimates,
  true_params,
  param_labels
)
```

```{r}
plot_metric(
  est_long,
  metric = "ARE",
  methods_keep = c('wrong fix',"all fix","minimax steps","minimax wells 3")
)
plot_raw_estimates(
  est_long,
  true_params,
  cap_outliers = TRUE,
  param_labels,
  ratio_value = 1000,
  method_names = c("random","local","average","pi","zero","0.5","uns","wrong fix","fix","all fix","argminVargminB steps","argminBargminV steps","minimax steps","argminVargminB wells 3","argminBargminV wells 3","minimax wells 3"),
  methods_keep = c("random","all fix","minimax wells 3")
)
```
